messages.subject: Project Mosaic - EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

I'm pleased to confirm we exchanged contracts this afternoon on Cygnet House. Completion is fixed for 10 October 2025. The 10% deposit of £2,175,000 has been released to Pemberton Rowe to hold as stakeholder. Risk in the property has passed to Marchwood on exchange, so please ensure buildings insurance is in place from today - I understand your broker has this in hand.

We'll now move to the pre-completion steps and will send the completion statement for approval shortly.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
DDI +44 (0)20 7946 0531
